shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!*'"\\.svg' -g '"'!*'"\\.png' -g '"'!*'"\\.jpg' | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(House|Persons|Gear|Bag|Magnifier|Bell|Arrow|Plus|Chevron|Sliders|Layers|Layout|CircleQuestion|Ellipsis|CreditCard|Clock|CircleCheck|Chart|Envelope|Calendar|Bars)["'^/]*.d.ts$'"' | head -65 && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '505,566p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head -85 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Bag|Bell|Calendar|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRight|ArrowLeft|Check|Xmark|Grip|ArrowsRotateRight|ChevronsLeft|ChevronsRight|CircleDollar)\\.d.ts"'$'"' && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg 'FooterItem.*d.ts' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' p='src/App.tsx' s=open(p).read().replace(\"size:42,minSize:42,enableColumnReordering:false},\", \"size:42,minSize:42,enableColumnReordering:false,enableSorting:false,cell:({row})=>},",1) s=s.replace('"'groupHeaderClassName=\"order-group\" getGroupTitle=', '''groupHeaderClassName=\"order-group\" getIsGroupHeaderRow={row=>Boolean(row.original.items)} renderGroupHeaderRowContent={({row,Cell,getGroupTitle})=>
} getGroupTitle='"''',1) s=s.replace(\" const stats=[\", \" const summaryOrders=orders.filter(o=>period==='all'||o.date==='2026-11-04');\\n const stats=[\") a=s.index(' const stats=['); b=s.index(' const statistics=',a) s=s[:a]+s[a:b].replace('orders.length','summaryOrders.length').replace('orders.filter','summaryOrders.filter')+s[b:] s=s.replace('Gravity UI eval','\\n \\n Orbit — Управление магазином');open(p,'w').write(s) PY cat >> src/styles.css <<'EOF' .group-row-cell{background:var(--sidebar-background);height:37px;border-top:1px solid var(--g-color-line-generic)}.group-row-content{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--g-spacing-3);padding:0 var(--g-spacing-5);height:37px}.group-toggle.g-button{height:32px;--g-button-padding:0;--g-button-background-color-hover:transparent}.group-toggle .group-title{margin-left:var(--g-spacing-1)} EOF npm run build"

import fs from 'node:fs';let s=fs.readFileSync('vitest.config.ts','utf8');s=s.replace(' plugins: [react()],',' plugins: [react()],\\n resolve: {alias: [{find: /"'^@gravity-ui'"\\\\/navigation"'$/, replacement: new URL('"\\'./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js\\', import.meta.url).pathname}]},');fs.writeFileSync('vitest.config.ts',s);

npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx"

npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx"
